title: Red and Blue
summary: A chromatic poem exploring color through all short vowel CVC words. Each color evokes emotion and sensory memory.

pages.scene: A vibrant red rose, warm and glowing against dark green leaves
Sunset painting the sky in deep reds and oranges, horizon glowing
A peaceful blue sky, vast and serene, stretching endlessly
A delicate blue cup with steam rising, sitting on a saucer
A small bug glistening with dew, moving through wet grass
Ripples spreading across wet brown mud after rain
A figure humming contentedly, surrounded by floating musical notes
Two figures in a garden, one in red, one in blue, holding hands

phonics_focus: CVC short i (hum, blue, cup - note: these are VCC pattern)
CVC short u (cup, hum, bug, mud, sun)

metadata.aesthetic_focus: Color as emotion, sensory warmth and calm
